description_en: Adds instances, databases, and tables to the specified permission template
description_zh: 调用此API给指定权限模板添加实例、数据库、表资源
name: AddAuthorityTemplateItems

parameters.description_en: The ID of the permission template. You can call the [CreateAuthorityTemplate](~~600705~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.
parameters.description_zh: 权限模板ID。您可通过调用[CreateAuthorityTemplate](~~600705~~)接口获取该参数的值。

element_fields.description_en:
The instance ID. You can call the [ListInstances](~~141936~~) or [GetInstance](~~141567~~) operation to query the instance ID.

> This parameter is required if the ResourceType parameter is set to INSTANCE.
element_fields.description_zh:
实例ID。您可调用[ListInstances](~~141936~~)或[GetInstance](~~141567~~)接口获取该参数的值。

> 该参数必填的情况：ResourceType参数值为INSTANCE。
element_fields.help_en:

element_fields.name: instance_id

element_fields.description_en:
The database ID. Databases are divided into physical databases and logical databases.

*   To query the ID of a physical database, call the [ListDatabases](~~141873~~) or [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~) operation.
*   To query the ID of a logical database, call the [ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~) or [SearchDatabase](~~141876~~) operation.

> This parameter is required if the ResourceType parameter is set to META_DB, LOGIC_DB, META_TABLE, or LOGIC_TABLE.
element_fields.description_zh:
数据库ID。数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：

- 物理库ID：可通过调用接口[ListDatabases](~~141873~~)或[SearchDatabase](~~141876~~)获取该参数的值。

- 逻辑库ID：可通过调用接口[ListLogicDatabases](~~141874~~)或[SearchDatabase](~~141876~~)获取该参数的值。

> 该参数必填的情况：ResourceType的参数值为META_DB、LOGIC_DB、META_TABLE、LOGIC_TABLE。
element_fields.help_en:
The database ID. Databases are divided into physical databases and logical databases.

*   To query the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
*   To query the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.

> This parameter is required if the ResourceType parameter is set to META_DB, LOGIC_DB, META_TABLE, or LOGIC_TABLE
element_fields.help_zh:
数据库ID。数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：

- 物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。

- 逻辑库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。

> 该参数必填的情况：ResourceType的参数值为META_DB、LOGIC_DB、META_TABLE、LOGIC_TABLE
element_fields.name: db_id

element_fields.description_en:
The table name. You can call the [ListTables](~~141878~~) operation to query the name of the table.

> This parameter is required if the ResourceType parameter is set to META_TABLE or LOGIC_TABLE.
element_fields.description_zh:
表名，您可以调用[ListTables](~~141878~~)接口获取该参数。

> 该参数必填的情况：ResourceType的参数值为META_TABLE或LOGIC_TABLE。
element_fields.help_en:

element_fields.name: table_name

element_fields.description_en:
The type of the resource from which you want to remove tags. Valid values:

*   **INSTANCE**: instance
*   **LOGIC_DB**: logical database
*   **META_DB**: physical database
*   **LOGIC_TABLE**: logical table
*   **LOGIC_TABLE**: physical table
element_fields.description_zh:
资源类型。取值如下：

- **INSTANCE**：实例。

- **LOGIC_DB**：逻辑库。

- **META_DB**：物理库。

- **LOGIC_TABLE**：逻辑表。

- **LOGIC_TABLE**：物理表。
